statement:
The record gives the value "active, renewing for another year" for this case.

judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record's "active, renewing" status contradicts the stated cancellation ("Tomas cancelled his Fitline membership on 3 July with written confirmation, so this renewal charge will not be processed").
